name: Business Analysis Fundamentals
lens: The role, strategy, elicitation and planning your analysis
summary: The core of the job: what business analysis is, how to find the real need and justify a change, how to draw out requirements from people and how to plan the analysis work.

name: Requirements, Modeling and Design
lens: Write, model and specify what must be built
summary: Write requirements that can be built and tested, capture behavior in stories and use cases, specify quality attributes, model systems and processes, define rules and data, and show ideas with wireframes.

name: Solutions, Validation and Delivery
lens: Choose, deliver, test and prove the solution
summary: Evaluate solution options, keep requirements under control, support agile and plan-driven delivery, verify and validate, and carry the change through to benefits.

name: Data and Technology for Analysts
lens: SQL, spreadsheets, analysis, dashboards and technology
summary: Query and check data with SQL, analyze with spreadsheets, turn data into trustworthy findings, build clear dashboards and understand the technology behind the systems you analyze.

name: Interview-Ready Business Analyst
lens: People, communication, tools, AI, certifications and interviews
summary: Turn what you have learned into practical skills and a portfolio: stakeholders, communication, tools, AI, certifications and interview practice. Practice only, so there is no certificate for this module.
